state_definition: raw OBS_VALUE observed at each source-defined wave; no threshold, composite, normalization, interpolation, or imputation
transition_definition: signed change in raw OBS_VALUE between adjacent source waves within the same economy-indicator series
predeclared_metric: maximum across the three adjacent wave intervals of cross-sectional directional concentration: max(fraction_up, fraction_down), excluding exact zero changes from numerator and denominator
null_method: within-series permutation of the four source-wave labels independently for every complete economy-indicator series; 10000 deterministic Monte Carlo replicates; maximum statistic retained across all three intervals
multiple_testing_control: single predeclared metric with max-statistic across three source intervals
complete_series_rule: retain only economy-indicator series with exactly one non-null OBS_VALUE at each of the four source waves; no fill or substitution
missing_data_policy: drop incomplete series from this transition metric and report counts; do not impute
split: descriptive_all_waves_only; no predictive train-validation-test claim because four source waves provide only three intervals
oos_policy: not available under this archive; result cannot be promoted to supported_predictive
expected_output_status: candidate, rejected, or not_testable; causal status prohibited
promotion_rule: no runtime or Composer promotion from this contract; any low p-value remains descriptive source-wave evidence pending independent vintage and holdout
